description: Four chain-envelope conformance vectors in the AAE shape, each decided by the shipped APS verifier (verifyDelegation + scopeCovers) via a small AAE->APS delegation-chain adapter.

vectors.aae_section: §2.2/2.3 scope (mandate.actions); child is a strict subset of parent
vectors.aps_reference: tests/property-delegation.test.ts (INV-2 Scope Monotonic Narrowing); core scopeCovers

vectors.expected_reason: scope-widening: child_scope is not a subset of parent_scope (child grants write/delete the delegator does not hold)
vectors.aps_reference: tests/property-delegation.test.ts (INV-2) and tests/v2/delegation-escalation.test.ts (delegation_scope_expansion); subDelegate raises 'Scope violation: [..] not in parent scope [..]'

vectors.expected_reason: parent validity.not_after is in the past; an expired ancestor invalidates the subtree
parent revocation_check resolves to revoked; revocation of an ancestor cascades to the subtree at verification time (check-time, not next-lookup)
vectors.aps_reference: tests/conformance/golden-fixtures/NEG-STALE-REVOCATION.json; verifyDelegation with cachedRevocationState marks the node revoked at check time

clarification_2026_10_05.note: Appended 2026-10-05 under CONTRIBUTING's rule for files not covered by a published digest set. Every member above is unchanged. aae_section values above use draft-kroehl-agentic-trust-aae-00 numbering. README.md section 'Clarification, 2026-10-05' has the full text.
clarification_2026_10_05.what_these_are: APS-encoded vectors in the AAE chain-envelope shape, authored in this repository at 1e75a47, decided by the APS verifier through the adapter in verify.ts. Not AAE-conformant envelopes and not decided by an AAE verifier.
clarification_2026_10_05.constraints_resource: Every vector, parent and child, carries constraints.resource. It is not an AAE constraint type and has no required member, so AAE -02 section 2.3 and section 5 step 7 treat it as an unrecognized required constraint: every vector is non-conforming AAE input as published. Vector files are not edited.
clarification_2026_10_05.revocation_check: AAE -02 section 2.4 defines revocation_check as an HTTPS URI template. The vectors carry an inline status object. verify.ts maps it to fixture-supplied revocation state (active -> fresh revoked:false, revoked -> revoked:true, missing or unrecognized -> absent evidence, rejected under fail_closed). Never live revocation resolution.

external_run_reported.original_vectors: all four REJECT at step 7, unrecognized_required_constraint
external_run_reported.modified_variant: In MoltyCel's reported modified run, removing resource made the compared decisions agree: V1 ACCEPT, V2 delegated_actions_not_subset, V3 expired_not_after, V4 ancestor_revoked. The modified variant is MoltyCel's, not a file in this directory.

runner_correction.defect: At f8d6eb4 and earlier, verify.ts requested fail_closed but supplied revocation evidence only for revoked. Active nodes were SDK valid=false (fail_closed: no revocation evidence supplied) while the runner decided V1 ACCEPT and reported 4/4. Earlier 4/4 records are kept as that runner's output.

commits.6fa874a: active status supplied as fresh revoked:false evidence
commits.fa276f5: SDK valid flag read per node; per-node consistency guard, not compared with the chain verdict
commits.78f666f: SDK-invalid node with no named reason rejects the chain (NODE_INVALID); mapping labeled fixture-supplied revocation state
commits.910b56c: regression test runners/ts/aae-envelope-revocation-evidence.test.ts, wired into npm test

run_910b56c.classification: author-produced, Mode A (APS verifier through the adapter); not an AAE verification

v3_masked_gap.aae_requirement: AAE -02 section 3 (Validity) and section 5 step 9: child window MUST nest inside the parent's. V3's child does not.
v3_masked_gap.aae_path_reason: Per MoltyCel's report, on the AAE verification path a run dated before 2026-03-01 rejects V3 for validity widening rather than expiry. That reason belongs to the AAE path; the APS adapter has no window-nesting check.
v3_masked_gap.how_evaluated: verifyDelegation (agent-passport-system 7.1.0) reads Date.now() at dist/src/core/delegation.js lines 280, 294, 332 and takes no evaluation-instant option (dist/src/core/delegation.d.ts line 116). The regression test overrides Date.now in its own process.
v3_masked_gap.status: masked interoperability gap, not a clean ancestor-expiry vector. V3 not edited; no replacement vector added in this change.

V1-narrowing-valid.-02: section 2.2 MANDATE, 2.3 CONSTRAINTS; actions-subset rule section 3 and section 5 step 9
